body.message:
I understand that the rates have been revised due to the current market conditions. However, I find the AED 1,000 increase quite unreasonable considering the current rental options in the same area. There are newer buildings and apartments available for around AED 6,000, so I don’t feel that the increased rate is justified for my apartment.
I would therefore kindly request that you allow me to extend for one more month at my current rate of AED 5,000. After that month, I will move out and will not be extending further.

I hope you can consider this as a reasonable compromise, and I would really appreciate your understanding.
